## Limitations

CORE-Bench is mainly built from SWE-bench-series and SWE-bench-style software-change data. It may therefore not fully capture retrieval on newly created or rapidly evolving repositories, and it does not yet include freshness-oriented metrics for such settings. Its diversity is also uneven: popular ecosystems contribute more examples, while long-tail languages and uncommon project structures remain underrepresented.
